reminder.title: {title}

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.badYear: That is not a year the calendar can show

list_agenda.description: List everything dated in a window — task due dates, order ETAs and reminders.

params.from: Start of the window, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.
params.to: End of the window, ISO 8601. Defaults to a week after the start.

list_reminders.description: List the reminders the caller has set.

create_reminder.description: Set a reminder that notifies the caller at a time or on a repeating schedule.

params.title: What the person should be reminded about, in their own words.
params.rrule: RFC 5545 rule, which MUST carry its own DTSTART: e.g. DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Moscow:20260105T100000 then RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO. A rule without DTSTART starts counting from the moment it is created, so "in two minutes" written as an interval has nothing ahead of it and is refused.
params.timezone: IANA zone the rule's wall clock is read in, e.g. Europe/Moscow. Omit it and the caller's own zone is used — say one only when the person asked for a different one.
params.ref: Canonical object reference the reminder is about, if any.
params.personal: False to show it to everyone with access to the workspace. Omit it for a reminder meant for the caller alone — which is what "remind me" means.

reschedule_reminder.description: Push a reminder's next run back by a number of minutes.

params.minutes: How many minutes to push it back.
